title: 第10章 抢我？
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
伊森正要推开最近的一扇门。

    身后传来脚步声。

    不是一个人。

    是很多人。

    伊森转过身。

    一百多人正朝这边走来。

    他们分成三个明显的阵营，各自占据一个方位，隐隐形成合围之势。

    左侧那伙人约有四十多个，为首的是个身材高瘦的少年，穿着一袭深蓝色镶银线的贵族服饰，腰间佩着一柄装饰华丽的细剑。他身后站着几个同样衣着考究的年轻人，一看就是出自贵族家庭。

    右侧那伙人人数最多，起码有六十往上，穿着杂乱，有粗布麻衣，也有皮质劲装。为首的是个光头壮汉，裸露的手臂上满是狰狞的伤疤，肌肉虬结如岩石，那双眼睛里透着股子狠厉。

    正前方那伙人约莫三十来个，穿着打扮最为怪异。为首的是个少女，看着不过十五六岁，一袭淡青色长裙，发间插着一支精巧的银色发钗。她身后站着几个同样穿着考究的男女，神情倨傲，看向伊森的目光如同在看一只待宰的羔羊。

    人群在距离他约莫十步远的位置停了下来。

    伊森的目光扫过这三伙人，最后落在那光头壮汉身上。

    有意思。

    这才刚上船，就有人迫不及待了。

    “新来的，”那光头壮汉率先开口，声音粗豪如钟，“知道规矩吗？”

    伊森挑了挑眉，没有接话。

    “新来的，得交孝敬。”光头壮汉咧嘴露出一口黄牙，伸手指了指伊森背上的行囊，“把身上所有的魔石和金币交出来，以后在这飞艇上，我们罩着你。”

    “没错。”左侧那高瘦贵族少年接口，声音尖细，“这是我们格林老大的规矩。识相的，乖乖交出来，免得受皮肉之苦。”

    正前方那淡青长裙少女没有开口，只是微微扬起下巴，居高临下地看着伊森，眼中闪过一丝不屑。

    伊森的目光从三伙人脸上扫过，最后落在那少女身上。

    “魔石？金币？”他的声音平静得听不出任何情绪，“就凭你们？”

    那光头壮汉脸色一变，正要发作。

    伊森动了。

    没有任何征兆，没有任何多余的动作。

    他右手按上腰间剑柄，脚下猛蹬甲板，整个人如同一支离弦的箭，瞬间跨越十步距离，直奔那光头壮汉而去！

    那壮汉瞳孔骤缩，下意识想拔武器。

    晚了。

    剑光一闪。

    “噗嗤！”

    一腔热血喷涌而出，溅在甲板上，触目惊心。

    光头壮汉的头颅高高飞起，在空中翻滚了几圈，重重砸在甲板上，骨碌碌滚出老远。

    尸体还站在原地，脖颈断口处鲜血如喷泉般狂涌，几息后才轰然倒地。

    【生命能量+11，当前生命能量：13。】

    全场死一般的寂静。
content_en:
Ethan was about to push open the nearest door.

    There were footsteps behind me.

    Not alone.

    It's a lot of people.

    Ethan turned around.

    More than a hundred people are walking this way.

    They were divided into three obvious camps, each occupying a position, forming a vague encirclement.

    There are about forty people in the group on the left. The leader is a tall and thin young man, wearing a dark blue aristocratic dress with silver thread, and an ornately decorated thin sword on his waist. Behind him stood several similarly well-dressed young people, who looked like they came from aristocratic families.

    The group on the right has the largest number of people, at least sixty and up. They are dressed in a mess, including coarse linen clothes and leather clothing. The leader was a bald man, his bare arms were covered with hideous scars, his muscles were as knotted as rocks, and his eyes were fierce.

    There were about thirty people in the group in front, and they were all dressed in the weirdest clothes. The leader was a girl who looked to be no more than fifteen or sixteen years old. She was wearing a light blue dress and had a delicate silver hairpin in her hair. Behind her stood several equally well-dressed men and women with arrogant expressions, looking at Ethan as if they were looking at a lamb waiting to be slaughtered.

    The crowd stopped about ten steps away from him.

    Ethan's eyes swept across the three groups, and finally landed on the bald man.

    interesting.

    As soon as we got on the boat, some people were already impatient.

    "New here," the bald man spoke first, his voice as rough as a bell, "Do you know the rules?"

    Ethan raised his eyebrows but did not answer.

    "Newcomers must be filial." The bald man grinned, showing yellow teeth, and pointed at the luggage on Ethan's back, "Hand over all the magic stones and gold coins you have on your body, and we will protect you on this airship from now on."

    "That's right." The tall, thin aristocratic young man on the left said with a shrill voice, "This is the rule of our boss Green. If you are wise, hand it over obediently, so as not to suffer physical pain."

    The girl in the light green dress in front did not speak, but raised her chin slightly and looked at Ethan condescendingly, with a trace of disdain in her eyes.

    Ethan's eyes swept across the faces of the three groups, and finally landed on the girl.

    "Magic stones? Gold coins?" His voice was so calm that no emotion could be heard, "Just you?"

    The bald man's expression changed, and he was about to have a seizure.

    Ethan moved.

    There were no signs, no unnecessary movements.

    He put his right hand on the hilt of the sword at his waist and kicked the deck with his feet. His whole body was like an arrow leaving the string, spanning ten steps in an instant and heading straight for the bald man!

    The strong man's pupils shrank suddenly, and he subconsciously wanted to draw his weapon.

    It's late.

    The sword flashed.

    "Pfft!"

    A burst of hot blood spurted out and splashed on the deck, which was shocking.

    The bald man's head flew high, rolled several times in the air, hit the deck hard, and rolled far away.

    The corpse was still standing there, with blood gushing from the broken neck like a fountain. After a few breaths, it collapsed to the ground.

    [Life energy +11, current life energy: 13. 】

    There was a deathly silence.
